summary: Corrected application protocol guarantees, DNS failover causation, authentication boundaries and operational caveats in paired chapters/quizzes.

HTTP3 residual blocking and conditional discovery/migration/performance clarified; WebSocket HTTP2/3 Extended CONNECT and socket ownership versus messaging clarified.
ICE/TURN connectivity/cost not guaranteed by NAT labels; gRPC channels can have zero or more connections and serialization performance is workload-dependent.
MQTT QoS2 delivery limited to protocol legs, not exactly-once business side effects; Will configuration/delay/reconnect and broker durability assumptions clarified.
